method: Person-icon HUD counts at 5-second sampling. Two English recognizers must agree on an exact two-digit value with confidence >=0.92 in both, with visible ticket HUD. Ambiguous first-digit 5 readings in the tiny green HUD are withheld for 3-versus-5 review, plus separately logged visual corrections. Missing readings remain null; no smoothing or interpolated flags. Observed runs end on missing or <=33 readings. Selected peaks are visually reviewed; the entire series is not manually verified.
